verdict.rationale: Retell documents a `call_analyzed` webhook event alongside `call_started` and `call_ended`, pushed to your server without polling. It also offers built-in call success and sentiment scoring plus custom fields synced to your CRM, which covers structured post-call outcomes delivered by webhook. Missing for 10: detailed docs on defining a custom extraction schema (entities, dispositions, field types), an explicit API endpoint for retrieving the analyzed data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
